text:
maria: Heads up — after the canary cutover at 13:02 UTC the latency dashboard's p95/p99 lines are gone for the API-prod route. Chart shows p50 only. Anyone else seeing this? Deploy id: deploy-20260326-7a2f. @kevin @raj

kevin: seeing it. graphs return only p50 and mean lines. No p95 or p99 series. Not an empty panel — legend doesn't list them.

ops-bot: Incident created: INC-2026-1743 — dashboard missing quantile series. Pinged eng-platform.

raj: quick check — Prometheus still has the buckets. Query for buckets returns data: `sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{route=\"/v1/generate\"}[5m])) by (le)` gives nonzero series.

sasha: could be the Grafana transformation that aggregates by `quantile_over_time`? I remember we switched the panel to use "transformations" during the template update in the canary.

maria: the dashboard JSON changed in the cutover? I diffed the panel and saw the query changed from `histogram_quantile(0.95, ...)` to `quantile_over_time(0.95, ...)` — that won't work for aggregated buckets. cc @kevin

kevin: I pulled the dashboard version from grafana: panel id 42, queryA is now `quantile_over_time(0.95, api_request_duration_seconds_bucket[5m])` — that's the bug. histogram_quantile needed with `sum(rate(...)) by (le)`. The templating replace accidentally applied.

raj: temp fix: patch panel to `histogram_quantile(0.95, sum(rate(api_request_duration_seconds_bucket{job=\"api-prod\"}[5m])) by (le))` and same for 0.99. I've applied a quick change in staging and panels reappear. Roll forward to prod?

maria: Can we do a hotfix in grafana and then ship a follow-up change to the dashboard repo? We need a rollback plan if patch fails.

sasha: patch applied to prod dashboard via grafana UI — p95/p99 lines returned. I'm keeping an eye on the panel. No alerts fired since quantile alerts are based on these series — we should ensure alerting still works.

kevin: root cause: our dashboard builder script replaced `histogram_quantile` with `quantile_over_time` when it saw the token "quantile" in the template. Will push a fix to generator and add unit test.

maria: filing a postmortem note + linking to the PR. Thanks everyone — great triage. :thumbsup:


dashboard-bot: Patch deployed to grafana at 2026-03-26T13:25:12Z by sasha.
